title: PMOVES.AI
subtitle: A Metal-Organic Framework for distributed machine intelligence
summary: Every node is a pore in a crystalline lattice through which autonomous agents flow — capacity-class, not expertise-lane. Rooms-on-a-stage, orchestrated by P7, grounded by CHIT geometry and Hi-RAG hybrid retrieval.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: A Metal-Organic Framework (MOF) for distributed machine intelligence — the crystalline lattice through which autonomous agents flow. Each node is a pore in the lattice, joined by capacity, not lane. Operationally: rooms-on-a-stage, with P7 as the room-aware stage manager selecting rooms, loading suits, and moving work through rehearsal, live, review, and archive.

sections.heading: How it converges
sections.body: Five layers — L1 Structure through L5 Economics — unify MOF, CHIT, the GEOMETRY_BUS, EVO SWARM, and ToKenism into one system. CHIT carries the mathematical through-line as compressed geometric packets; Hi-RAG v2 fuses vector, graph, and full-text retrieval; NATS is the event plane; and a sovereign, layered egress (Tailscale, Mullvad, Reticulum, Haven) keeps the mesh private and self-hosted.

sections.heading: Provenance
sections.body: Content is shaped before ingest so one semantic bundle drives living docs, motion clips, and Hyperdimensions overlays without copy drift — reviewable before it becomes an artifact.
